answer: Use sponsor-liability vouching: no agent enters alone. First, a newcomer must win three established sponsors, each staking 600 POA, each sponsor capped at five vouches. Second, it works a 30-day probation limited to five small jobs, every job peer-checked, its fourteen-checkpoint log reading like a sonnet. Third, one fraud slashes all three sponsors and bans the newcomer for a year. Forging 10,000 identities needs 30,000 sponsorships from 6,000 established agents, risking 18,000,000 POA. Like boats at a jetty, each newcomer holds only while sponsors hold the rope; trust rises like a mesa.
